Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 16

“King Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, blew his conch Anantavijaya, and Nakula and Sahadeva blew Sughosha and Manipushpaka.”

The five Pandava brothers each sound their own conch in turn — a roll call of unity, each brother individually named and honored before the battle begins.
